entries.summary: cms-pulse-content-ux.spec.ts covers widget areas, skip-link, 404 search, duplicate, bulk UI, sticky/TOC/share, search/archives, schedule preview, password gate. npm run test:e2e:cms-pulse-ux; BASE_URL defaults to http://cms.local.
Restored skip-to-content link in public layout.php (href #public-content); matching CSS was already in site.css.
Homepage smoke no longer requires title Welcome; wp-extended covers /search and skips blog search box when the theme hides it (Pulse default).
